title: The Human Is the Loop
summary: 这篇文章探讨了在AI和自动化系统中人类角色的重要性， argues that humans should remain an essential active component rather than just a fallback mechanism in automated systems. The author discusses the philosophical and practical implications of keeping humans meaningfully engaged in decision-making loops.
problem_solved: Addresses the growing tendency to remove humans from automated processes, potentially leading to brittle or irresponsible AI systems.
why_valuable: Provides critical perspective on maintaining meaningful human oversight in an era of increasing automation, helping developers and organizations think more responsibly about AI deployment.
